Serco is the place for you! We have an exciting opportunity supporting the United States Navy and our CNIC N6 program at NSA Naples in Naples, Italy. CNIC Regional Offices enable improving operational performance and cost reductions through business process definition, analysis, and development of technical capabilities which automate process or improve transparency for analytics and decision making. In This Role, You Will Support the installation, configuration, testing, maintenance and upgrade of physical and virtual servers, storage systems and virtualization platforms, and upgrade of hybrid cloud environments, including physical/virtual servers, storage systems, and cloud virtualization platforms. Support the development, design, configuration/setup, test, maintenance and upgrade of the application hosting environment using virtualization application such as VMWare ESXi, Hyper-V or other applicable virtualization platform. review_candidates.title: Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description: Position Description Help build and evolve the cloud environments that enable CGI's clients to transform how they operate. As a Cloud Engineer, you'll deliver and support private, public and hybrid cloud solutions across leading platforms, using automation and modern engineering approaches to create reliable, scalable services. You'll take ownership of technical challenges, contribute ideas that improve how we deliver and work alongside experienced colleagues across a diverse range of client engagements. With opportunities to broaden your cloud expertise and develop your career, you'll be part of a growing, collaborative team where you can experiment with new approaches, share your knowledge and see the impact of your work. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK 'Best Employer' by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you'll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We'll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This is a hybrid position. Your future duties and responsibilities In this role, you will help deliver, develop and support private, public and hybrid cloud solutions across Azure, AWS, OCI and GCP environments. You'll take responsibility for technical activities across multiple client engagements, contribute to CGI's Global Hybrid Cloud management platform and provide high-quality support to clients and internal teams. You'll also have opportunities to find creative ways to improve cloud operations through scripting, automation and repeatable deployment approaches. Working alongside supportive cloud engineering colleagues, you'll contribute throughout the delivery lifecycle while developing your technical expertise and helping clients achieve successful outcomes. Deliver & Support: Implement and support private, public and hybrid cloud solutions across client environments. Develop & Integrate: Contribute to the development and support of CGI's Global Hybrid Cloud management platform. Automate & Improve: Build scripts and frameworks that automate and integrate centralised infrastructure management. Provision & Scale: Create and maintain deployment blueprints that enable rapid, repeatable provisioning. Monitor & Optimise: Support capacity planning and operational reporting to improve service performance. Engage & Resolve: Provide high-quality technical support to clients, engineering teams and other stakeholders. Collaborate & Contribute: Work across ongoing client engagements, sharing ideas and taking responsibility for successful delivery. Support Growth: Contribute technical expertise to bids and opportunities alongside sales and client management teams. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role You should have a solid grounding in infrastructure technologies alongside practical exposure to public cloud environments, automation and modern engineering practices. You'll be comfortable taking initiative, solving problems and working across multiple client environments while collaborating effectively with technical colleagues, clients and senior stakeholders. Strong core infrastructure knowledge covering compute, networking and storage. Experience working with one or more public cloud platforms, such as Azure, AWS, OCI or GCP. Knowledge of tools such as Ansible, Elastic, Kibana, Rundeck and Git. Scripting capability using Python and/or PowerShell. Knowledge of container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes. Understanding of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) environments. Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with clients and senior stakeholders. Ability to work independently and take ownership while contributing to a collaborative team. Experience working in fast-paced environments supporting multiple clients. A proactive approach to investigating and resolving technical issues. Desirable experience Five or more years of relevant experience in disciplines such as server virtualisation, Wintel, UNIX, SAN or networking. Experience with virtualisation technologies including VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V. Experience across AWS, Azure, OCI or GCP, including IaaS and PaaS. Experience implementing monitoring solutions within cloud environments. Knowledge of VMware SDDC, including vCenter, vSphere and vSAN. Exposure to digital transformation programmes. Understanding of cloud automation and orchestration concepts and design. Experience automating repetitive activities through scripting or workload-automation tools. Familiarity with multi-tier escalation and on-call procedures. Together, as owners, let's turn meaningful insights into action. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you'll reach your full potential because... You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That's why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company's strategy and direction. Your work creates value. You'll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. You'll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You'll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons. That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals. Come join our team-one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

review_candidates.title: Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the Role Our world-leading Time & Frequency department are seeking a Platform Engineer with experience in scripting and automation. This is an exceptional opportunity to join the global authority in precision timing at a defining moment for UK digital infrastructure. Backed by a government investment of £180 million in the National Timing Centre (NTC) programme, we are developing a world-first resilient time distribution capability that will provide industry with a robust complement to satellite systems (such as GPS) – which are increasingly vulnerable to disruption from solar storms, jamming and spoofing. review_candidates.title: DevOps Automation Engineer
review_candidates.description: Who we are Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Preemptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions — giving organizations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do. About the role We're hiring a DevOps Automation Engineer to help Securin replace manual operational processes with AI-assisted, automated ones. The focus of this role goes beyond maintaining our existing pipelines: you'll look across our build, deploy, security, and infrastructure workflows to find the repetitive, human-in-the-loop work and systematically automate it. You'll work within our established DevOps stack — Terraform, Jenkins, SonarQube, and AWS — and use coding agents as a primary implementation tool. We're investing in AI-assisted development because it lets a small team deliver far more, and we're looking for someone who can take advantage of that leverage while maintaining full ownership of the quality of what ships. We're not attached to any particular tool. If there's a better option than what we run today — a different CI system, a different scanner — we're open to the conversation. What we care about is how a change like that is carried out: our developers are the users of this tooling, and any migration needs to be methodical, well-communicated, and supportive of them at every step. Their day-to-day work should keep flowing throughout the transition. This role also serves as an important bridge to our India-based DevOps team. You'll partner with them regularly, align on shared standards and ownership, and help the two sides of the organization operate as one team. We're looking for someone who is comfortable in this kind of environment and ready to contribute early. Direct experience with our specific CI and code-quality tools is welcome but not required — if you've done this work with comparable tooling, that transfers. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with a clear mandate and real autonomy. What you'll do Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone operational processes and replace them with automated, AI-assisted workflows — and measure the time and toil recovered. Build and maintain infrastructure as code in Terraform: modules, state strategy, environment promotion, drift detection, and remediation. Own and extend Jenkins pipelines across build, test, security scan, artifact, and deploy stages, including shared libraries and reusable pipeline patterns. Integrate and tune SonarQube quality gates so that code quality and security findings surface what matters without creating noise. Use coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as a primary implementation vehicle — decomposing problems, defining specs and guardrails, directing the work, and reviewing the results thoroughly. Design and troubleshoot systems end to end across AWS, including compute, networking, IAM, storage, and how these services behave under failure. Investigate and resolve production and pipeline incidents, then capture what you learned in runbooks and automation so the same issue doesn't return. Partner with the India DevOps team on shared standards, on-call practices, and clear handoffs, including attending late-evening meetings a few times per week to maintain meaningful overlap with their working hours. Evaluate whether our current tooling is still the right fit, and where a change is warranted, plan and execute the migration methodically — treating our developers as the users of the platform and keeping them supported and productive throughout. Document what you build, so the automation you create is understandable and maintainable by the whole team. What this looks like in practice A few examples of the kind of work we have in mind: An on-demand SQL runner agent. Most of the database migrations are versioned in the code and run as part of the deployment process. In some cases, we need to make ad-hoc changes to configuration tables. Rather than routing database changes through a person, an agent validates the SQL, executes it against the appropriate cloud infrastructure, monitors the run to completion, and reports back on progress and outcome. A virtual developer. An agent that handles well-understood, boilerplate implementation work end to end — writing the change, verifying it builds and passes tests, and opening a pull request that's ready for human review. These are illustrative rather than prescriptive. Part of the role is identifying which opportunities are worth pursuing and in what order. Requirements Candidates must reside in or be within commuting distance to Albuquerque, NM. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must not require current or future employment visa sponsorship. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, including verification of prior employment. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 2+ years of hands-on AWS experience across core services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudWatch), including a practical understanding of how they behave under failure. Production experience with infrastructure as code, using any mainstream tool (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, CloudFormation/CDK, or similar) — you've designed and owned infrastructure definitions, not only worked within someone else's modules. Experience owning CI/CD pipelines in production, with any mainstream tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Azure DevOps, or similar) — the concepts matter more to us than the specific product. Strong system design fundamentals: the ability to reason about tradeoffs, failure domains, state, idempotency, and blast radius before writing code. Strong system troubleshooting skills: a methodical, evidence-driven approach to debugging distributed systems and CI/CD pipelines, including under time pressure. Strong programming principles — software engineering discipline (testing, version control, modularity, code review, readable code) applied to infrastructure and tooling. Proficiency in Python, Go, or a comparable language. Experience using coding agents for substantive implementation work, along with the judgment to evaluate agent output critically and review it to the same standard as your own. Willingness to work with a distributed team across time zones, including late-evening meetings a few times per week with our India DevOps team. A developer-as-customer mindset: the judgment to weigh a tooling change on its merits, and the discipline to migrate in careful, well-communicated stages rather than disruptive cutovers. Clear written communication — much of your work will be documented for colleagues in other time zones. Nice to have Direct experience with Terraform — this is what we use today, alongside Jenkins and SonarQube. Direct experience with Jenkins, including shared libraries and reusable pipeline patterns. Direct experience with SonarQube or comparable static analysis and code-quality gating (Snyk, Semgrep, Checkmarx, CodeQL). Containers and orchestration at production scale (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS). Observability tooling (CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and experience building alerting that teams trust. Security and compliance automation — secrets management, policy as code, SOC 2 or similar audit evidence collection. Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling. Prior experience bridging onshore and offshore engineering teams. Background in security or vulnerability management products. Benefits Medical Insurance Multiple plan options with low deductibles and competitive rates for individuals and families. Dental Insurance High and low plan options with 100% coverage for preventive care. Vision Insurance Coverage for exams, glasses, and contacts with generous allowances. Life & AD&D Insurance Company-paid basic life insurance; optional supplemental coverage for employees and dependents. Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Income protection up to 60% of earnings for qualifying disabilities. Flexible Enrollment with Rippling Easy online platform for managing benefits and life event changes. MaxFlex Unlimited PTO 401K Benefit

Partner closely with software engineers developing C++, Java, C# and Python applications. Improve CI/CD, deployment tooling and overall platform reliability through automation.
